```typescript
import * as pulumi from "@pulumi/pulumi";
import * as tencentcloud from "@tencentcloud_iac/pulumi";

const vpc = new tencentcloud.vpc.Instance("vpc", {
    name: "vpc-example",
    cidrBlock: "10.0.0.0/16",
});
const subnet = new tencentcloud.subnet.Instance("subnet", {
    availabilityZone: "ap-guangzhou-6",
    name: "subnet-example",
    vpcId: vpc.id,
    cidrBlock: "10.0.0.0/16",
    isMulticast: false,
});
const example = new tencentcloud.vpc.Ipv6CidrBlock("example", {vpcId: vpc.id});
const exampleIpv6SubnetCidrBlock = new tencentcloud.vpc.Ipv6SubnetCidrBlock("example", {
    vpcId: vpc.id,
    ipv6SubnetCidrBlocks: {
        subnetId: subnet.id,
        ipv6CidrBlock: "2402:4e00:1015:7500::/64",
    },
});
const exampleInstance = new tencentcloud.eni.Instance("example", {
    name: "tf-example",
    vpcId: vpc.id,
    subnetId: subnet.id,
    description: "eni description.",
    ipv4Count: 1,
}, {
    dependsOn: [
        example,
        exampleIpv6SubnetCidrBlock,
    ],
});
const exampleIpv6Address = new tencentcloud.eni.Ipv6Address("example", {
    networkInterfaceId: exampleInstance.id,
    ipv6AddressCount: 1,
});
```

<pulumi-choosable type="language" values="go">

```go
package main

import (
	"github.com/pulumi/pulumi/sdk/v3/go/pulumi"
	"github.com/tencentcloudstack/pulumi-tencentcloud/sdk/go/tencentcloud/eni"
	"github.com/tencentcloudstack/pulumi-tencentcloud/sdk/go/tencentcloud/subnet"
	"github.com/tencentcloudstack/pulumi-tencentcloud/sdk/go/tencentcloud/vpc"
)

func main() {
	pulumi.Run(func(ctx *pulumi.Context) error {
		vpc2, err := vpc.NewInstance(ctx, "vpc", &vpc.InstanceArgs{
			Name:      pulumi.String("vpc-example"),
			CidrBlock: pulumi.String("10.0.0.0/16"),
		})
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		subnet2, err := subnet.NewInstance(ctx, "subnet", &subnet.InstanceArgs{
			AvailabilityZone: pulumi.String("ap-guangzhou-6"),
			Name:             pulumi.String("subnet-example"),
			VpcId:            vpc2.ID().ToIDOutput().ToStringOutput(),
			CidrBlock:        pulumi.String("10.0.0.0/16"),
			IsMulticast:      pulumi.Bool(false),
		})
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		example, err := vpc.NewIpv6CidrBlock(ctx, "example", &vpc.Ipv6CidrBlockArgs{
			VpcId: vpc2.ID().ToIDOutput().ToStringOutput(),
		})
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		exampleIpv6SubnetCidrBlock, err := vpc.NewIpv6SubnetCidrBlock(ctx, "example", &vpc.Ipv6SubnetCidrBlockArgs{
			VpcId: vpc2.ID().ToIDOutput().ToStringOutput(),
			Ipv6SubnetCidrBlocks: &vpc.Ipv6SubnetCidrBlockIpv6SubnetCidrBlocksArgs{
				SubnetId:      subnet2.ID().ToIDOutput().ToStringOutput(),
				Ipv6CidrBlock: pulumi.String("2402:4e00:1015:7500::/64"),
			},
		})
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		exampleInstance, err := eni.NewInstance(ctx, "example", &eni.InstanceArgs{
			Name:        pulumi.String("tf-example"),
			VpcId:       vpc2.ID().ToIDOutput().ToStringOutput(),
			SubnetId:    subnet2.ID().ToIDOutput().ToStringOutput(),
			Description: pulumi.String("eni description."),
			Ipv4Count:   pulumi.Int(1),
		}, pulumi.DependsOn([]pulumi.Resource{
			example,
			exampleIpv6SubnetCidrBlock,
		}))
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		_, err = eni.NewIpv6Address(ctx, "example", &eni.Ipv6AddressArgs{
			NetworkInterfaceId: exampleInstance.ID().ToIDOutput().ToStringOutput(),
			Ipv6AddressCount:   pulumi.Int(1),
		})
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		return nil
	})
}
```

```java
package generated_program;

import com.pulumi.Context;
import com.pulumi.Pulumi;
import com.pulumi.core.Output;
import com.pulumi.tencentcloud.Vpc.Ipv6CidrBlock;
import com.pulumi.tencentcloud.Vpc.Ipv6CidrBlockArgs;
import com.pulumi.tencentcloud.Vpc.Ipv6SubnetCidrBlock;
import com.pulumi.tencentcloud.Vpc.Ipv6SubnetCidrBlockArgs;
import com.pulumi.tencentcloud.Vpc.inputs.Ipv6SubnetCidrBlockIpv6SubnetCidrBlocksArgs;
import com.pulumi.tencentcloud.Eni.Ipv6Address;
import com.pulumi.tencentcloud.Eni.Ipv6AddressArgs;
import com.pulumi.resources.CustomResourceOptions;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.Map;
import java.io.File;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.Paths;

public class App {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Pulumi.run(App::stack);
    }

    public static void stack(Context ctx) {
        var vpc = new com.pulumi.tencentcloud.Vpc.Instance("vpc", com.pulumi.tencentcloud.Vpc.InstanceArgs.builder()
            .name("vpc-example")
            .cidrBlock("10.0.0.0/16")
            .build());

        var subnet = new com.pulumi.tencentcloud.Subnet.Instance("subnet", com.pulumi.tencentcloud.Subnet.InstanceArgs.builder()
            .availabilityZone("ap-guangzhou-6")
            .name("subnet-example")
            .vpcId(vpc.id())
            .cidrBlock("10.0.0.0/16")
            .isMulticast(false)
            .build());

        var example = new Ipv6CidrBlock("example", Ipv6CidrBlockArgs.builder()
            .vpcId(vpc.id())
            .build());

        var exampleIpv6SubnetCidrBlock = new Ipv6SubnetCidrBlock("exampleIpv6SubnetCidrBlock", Ipv6SubnetCidrBlockArgs.builder()
            .vpcId(vpc.id())
            .ipv6SubnetCidrBlocks(Ipv6SubnetCidrBlockIpv6SubnetCidrBlocksArgs.builder()
                .subnetId(subnet.id())
                .ipv6CidrBlock("2402:4e00:1015:7500::/64")
                .build())
            .build());

        var exampleInstance = new com.pulumi.tencentcloud.Eni.Instance("exampleInstance", com.pulumi.tencentcloud.Eni.InstanceArgs.builder()
            .name("tf-example")
            .vpcId(vpc.id())
            .subnetId(subnet.id())
            .description("eni description.")
            .ipv4Count(1)
            .build(), CustomResourceOptions.builder()
                .dependsOn(                
                    example,
                    exampleIpv6SubnetCidrBlock)
                .build());

        var exampleIpv6Address = new Ipv6Address("exampleIpv6Address", Ipv6AddressArgs.builder()
            .networkInterfaceId(exampleInstance.id())
            .ipv6AddressCount(1)
            .build());

    }
}
```

## Import



vpc eni ipv6 address can be imported using the id, e.g.

```sh
$ pulumi import tencentcloud:Eni/ipv6Address:Ipv6Address example eni-fxrx5d1d
```

To learn more about importing existing cloud resources, see [Importing resources](/docs/using-pulumi/adopting-pulumi/import/).
